project_type: TypeScript monorepo (npm workspaces): React+Vite frontend (Japanese UI), Node Lambda backend, shared domain lib, AWS CDK infra
build_system: npm workspaces. Root `npm run build` builds @ddm/shared (tsc) -> @ddm/backend -> @ddm/frontend (tsc && vite build) -> infra (tsc). Shared/frontend tests use the Node built-in test runner with --experimental-strip-types (no bundler, no jest).
test_framework: node:test + node:assert/strict. Shared: `node --test --experimental-strip-types src/__tests__/*.ts`. Frontend pure helpers: `node --experimental-strip-types --test src/game-ui.test.ts` (DOM/React kept OUT of this file).
verification_instructions: 1) npm run build  2) npm test  3) npm test -w @ddm/frontend  All must pass. New pure helpers must have node:test coverage.
snapshot_or_generated_files: null (no snapshots; infra/cdk.out is generated CDK output, not touched by this task)
setup_instructions: npm install at repo root (workspaces). Node >=20.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET. No new runtime dependencies allowed. Keep UI Japanese-only (i18n is a separate issue #12).
contribution_requirements: Do NOT push or open PRs (orchestrator does that). Work on branch feat/evolution-conditions-ui off main. Do not touch backup/previous-main. One logical commit preferred.
key_patterns: Pure, dependency-free helpers live in packages/shared/src/stages.ts (near STAGES config) and packages/frontend/src/ui-helpers.ts; both tested via node:test. STAGES array holds evolveRequirement {minTrainingCount, minAgeMs} per stage; evolveRequirement is null for terminal 'ultimate'. Monster has stageId, trainingCount, bornAt. StatsPanel.tsx renders stage badge + trainingCount; styles use .panel/.stat-row/.stat-label/.bar conventions in styles.css.
relevant_files: packages/frontend/src/App.tsx (footer already mentions 進化条件)
directory_structure: packages/shared (domain logic+tests), packages/backend (Lambda), packages/frontend (React UI, components/, state/useMonster.ts, ui-helpers.ts, styles.css), infra (CDK)
